articles.title: Scientists May Have Spotted the Soviet Union Lander That’s Been Missing for 60 Years
articles.summary: On February 3, 1966, the Soviet Union's Luna 9 achieved a monumental feat, becoming the first human-made object to successfully soft-land on the lunar surface. This historic mission also transmitted the first photographs directly from the Moon, marking a pivotal moment in space exploration. It demonstrated advanced technological capability and significantly contributed to humanity's understanding of the lunar environment, pushing the boundaries of scientific discovery.

articles.title: bindantic added to PyPI
articles.summary: Bindantic is a Python library designed to automate BIND9 DNS server configuration. It allows administrators to define DNS settings using Pydantic models, eliminating manual `named.conf` file editing. This library automatically generates configurations, significantly reducing errors and enhancing efficiency in server administration. It streamlines the deployment and maintenance of critical DNS infrastructure.

articles.title: Israeli soldier and citizen accused of using classified information to bet on air strikes
articles.summary: An Israeli reserve soldier and citizen have been indicted for allegedly using classified information to place bets on military operations via the Polymarket website. This case underscores severe security vulnerabilities within defence systems and the potential for individuals to exploit sensitive intelligence for personal gain, jeopardizing national security and operational integrity.

articles.title: Israel charges two over betting on military operations
articles.summary: Two Israelis have been charged with allegedly using classified military information to place bets on Polymarket. This serious breach, involving military secrets exploited for personal financial gain on a prediction market platform, is under joint investigation by Israel's Defence Ministry, Shin Bet security service, and police. The incident raises significant national security concerns regarding information integrity and potential insider threats.

articles.title: DAP 2026: India's new defence procurement policy aims for indigenous tech sovereignty

articles.title: Naravane memoir leak: Delhi Police questions Penguin India team, probes conspiracy angle
articles.summary: Delhi Police is investigating the alleged leak of retired Army chief General M M Naravane's unpublished memoir. Representatives from Penguin India, the book's publisher, were questioned as part of this probe. The investigation focuses on how confidential details from the former Army Chief's upcoming book might have been prematurely disclosed, raising concerns over information security protocols.
